used: Native four-channel UGH! TFMX engine recovered with IRA; existing GodLib Lance/Leonard Paula backends. No ScummVM or generic TFMX decoder imported.

immediate DMA gate/latch on every original DMACON write; scratch IRQ/CIA registers
four 672-byte bounded/stitched source windows for live TFMX loop changes on Lance
block doubling for tiny source loops; consumed-source/phase feedback
shared exclusive DMA ownership and clean shutdown
start completed Lance DMA buffer before variable-cost sequence/window work
zero-copy Lance window when the current sample has at least 672 bytes remaining
saturate TFMX envelope volume to 0..64 at Lance input, matching Leonard; prevent volume-65 paired-voice dropouts and out-of-bounds LMC lookup

format: UGH! four-voice TFMX-SONG MDAT + SMPL, PAL STE, 12.5/25 kHz
